mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.game_id, c.updated_at, COUNT(m.id) AS message_count FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.conversation_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.game_id, c.updated_at ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
SELECT id, title, game_id, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation(title, game_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{title}, #{gameId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
